title: The Garden of Caerlum
author: F. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Quentin Joubert, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
